anomalies.description: The ingested document is a DATEV 'EINGANGSRECHNUNG' booking sheet prepared by the mandant; the original supplier invoice from Büro & Mehr GmbH is referenced but not included in this upload.
anomalies.impact: Payment details (IBAN/BIC, Zahlungsziel, formale USt-IdNr.) cannot be verified from this file alone and should be cross-checked against the original invoice stored separately in the Kanzlei's DMS.

notes: Treat this extraction as the canonical DATEV booking proposal for ER-2026-0031 (Bürobedarf Büro & Mehr GmbH).
Use the three SKR03 booking lines as-is when reconciling against bank or cash payments, keeping the net, VAT, and gross totals tied back to this document and the separate original invoice.

If payment reconciliation flags discrepancies (e.g., different amount or missing payment), request the original supplier invoice from the Kanzlei's DMS via the Client Communication Agent instead of inferring missing payment details from this sheet.
